You're standing in the suffocating, dusty silence of room 103. That's the core of Do Not Say We Have Nothing by Madeleine Thien — and it's not what you'd expect.

By the end you'll walk away with the book's biggest takeaways and one reframing you can actually use. No fluff, no ending spoilers.
